### Are You Living Christ’s Full Power?
Author: Kelly Balarie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-january-6-2017.html
Passage: Colossians 1:27
Points:
- Believers often hold back instead of allowing Christ's strength to flow through them.
- Jesus dwells in believers not merely to stay hidden, but to work outwardly.
- Christians are empowered by the same divine power that raised Jesus from the dead.
- Unbelief can paralyze believers, while trusting God's inner presence enables world-changing impact.
- Believers can step out boldly and shine God's light without fear or timidity.

### Do People See Jesus in You?
Author: Robin Dugall
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/do-people-see-jesus-in-you-homeword-december-14.html
Passage: Colossians 1:27
Points:
- The indwelling mystery of Christ becomes visible through simple, selfless acts of service.
- Jesus is seen when believers comfort the sick, show hospitality, and care for those who suffer.
- Humble work, sincere teaching, and everyday kindness reflect the heart of Jesus to the world.
- Christians are challenged to evaluate whether others can clearly see Christ living in them.
